title: Humpback-Whale-Song-on-the-Southern-Ocean-Feeding-Grounds-Implications-for-Cultural-Transmission-pone.0079422.s003
author: Garland E, Gedamke J, Rekdahl M, Noad M, Garrigue C, Gales N
changes: Humpback whale (Megaptera novaeangliae) song unit. Trimmed to 46.20–47.90 s of the original, mixed to mono, gentle 12 dB/oct high-pass at 120 Hz, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. The high-pass is set to 120 Hz because the hydrophone recording has strong rumble below 100 Hz; the moan itself sits at about 200 Hz and above.
